item.title: Hardwood Classic Preview: Nine local teams still have state trophy hopes
item.description: The field of 15 local basketball teams that advanced to the state playoffs has been cut nearly in half.

item.title: Dow drops 400 after trimming an early plunge of 1,200 as oil prices climb even higher
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — A sell-off for stocks wrapped around the world and hit Wall Street Tuesday, while oil prices climbed even higher on worries about the widening war with Iran. But the big moves that rocked markets in the morning eased substantially as the day progressed.

item.title: La Center woman’s federal charges dismissed after appeal
item.description: Federal Clean Air Act charges filed against La Center resident Tracy Coiteux were dismissed Monday by U.S. District Judge Benjamin H. Settle after she appealed her 2024 conviction.

item.title: ‘This trial is happening in interesting times’: Trial seeks to tie Iran’s Guard to U.S. assassination plot
item.description: NEW YORK — While the U.S. fights a widening war in Iran, American prosecutors are airing claims that Iran’s paramilitary Revolutionary Guard was entangled in a foiled 2024 assassination plot that eyed then-candidate Donald Trump as a possible target.

item.title: Michael Jackson molested boy at homes of Elton John, Elizabeth Taylor, lawsuit alleges
item.description: LOS ANGELES — Four siblings who were part of Michael Jackson's secret "second family" have filed a lawsuit revealing the depths of the alleged sexual abuse they suffered as children, including claims that the singer molested one of the boys at the homes of Elton John and Elizabeth Taylor.

item.title: Pentagon says 4 US soldiers who died in Iran war were reservists who worked in logistics
item.description: DES MOINES, Iowa — Four of the six U.S. soldiers killed in the Iran war were identified Tuesday by the Pentagon as members of the Army Reserve from different states who worked in logistics and kept troops supplied with food and equipment.

item.title: Seahawks don’t place tag on RB Kenneth Walker III
item.description: As expected, the Seattle Seahawks did not place a franchise or transition tag on running back Kenneth Walker III by Tuesday’s 1 p.m. deadline.

item.title: WA governor: Passage of income tax could slip to 2027
item.description: Washington Gov. Bob Ferguson warned Tuesday that the income tax Democratic state lawmakers are pressing to approve in the next nine days might have to wait until next year.
